title: API Enterprise Sales Executive (Greek-Speaking)
description: **About Revolut** People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. They help companies automate multi-currency payouts, issue cards, and streamline treasury operations through our powerful APIs. We're looking for an API Enterprise Sales Executive to drive enterprise deal cycles, from initial conversation through close and early account growth, by overseeing a diverse customer book. You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that uses consultative selling to build long-lasting partnerships as we scale our API products globally. Up to shape what's next in finance? Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. **Important notice for candidates:** Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. * Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. * Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. **We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.** If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Account Development Representative (ADR)
description: Sales at Tractian The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Tractian, generating new opportunities, acquiring top-tier customers like Hyundai, Bosch, and Kraft Heinz, and strengthening relationships with our current accounts. Backed by strategic investors with a track record of building unicorns, Tractian is poised to set new benchmarks in industrial technology. Recognized on the Forbes AI 50 list in 2024 and ranked in the 98th percentile by RepVue for inbound leads, we deliver undeniable value—boosting machine reliability, delivering immediate ROI, and achieving world-class revenue retention that matches the best in tech. At Tractian, top performers are recognized, rewarded, and empowered to overachieve their goals. What you'll do As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Tractian, you will support revenue growth by identifying and qualifying new business opportunities within your assigned market. You will engage prospective customers through structured outbound and inbound outreach, build early-stage pipeline, and partner closely with Account Executives to support successful deal progression. You will use HubSpot CRM to manage prospect interactions, track activity, and ensure accurate pipeline visibility, while developing a strong understanding of Tractian’s software and hardware solutions to effectively communicate value to potential customers. **Responsibilities** * Proactively prospect and generate new qualified business opportunities through structured outbound and inbound outreach activities. * Research and identify target accounts, contacts, and buying signals to support effective pipeline development. * Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined criteria and schedule meetings for Account Executives. * Use HubSpot CRM to track prospect interactions, manage activity, and maintain accurate pipeline and reporting data. * Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Engineering to align messaging, handoffs, and qualification standards. * Analyze market segments, customer profiles, and outreach performance to continuously improve prospecting effectiveness. * Participate in industry events, campaigns, and targeted initiatives to support new opportunity creation when applicable. * Provide regular updates on outreach activity, pipeline contribution, and progress toward individual and team targets. **Requirements** * 2+ years of experience in outbound prospecting, sales development, or business development, preferably within a B2B software, industrial technology, or SaaS environment. * Demonstrated ability to generate qualified pipeline through structured outbound activities, including cold calling, email outreach, and account-based prospecting. * Experience working toward clearly defined activity and pipeline targets in a performance-driven sales environment. * Proficiency using CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) to manage prospect interactions, track activity, and maintain accurate reporting. * Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage professionally with a range of customer stakeholders. * Experience using outbound prospecting and sales engagement tools such as Apollo, Lusha, or similar platforms (in compliance with local data protection regulations). * Analytical and curious mindset, with the ability to quickly understand customer challenges and articulate value in early-stage conversations. * Interest in long-term career development within sales, with the potential to progress into an Account Executive role based on performance. **Compensation & Benefits** * Full-time employment with statutory social insurance contributions * Paid vacation, plus public holidays * Pension scheme with employer match * International travel for company kick-off events at our global headquarters * Wellhub Membership – Access a wide range of gyms and training programs * Long-Term Benefit – After four years of service, enjoy a fully funded trip anywhere in the world

title: Account Executive, Velocity SMB Hunter
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** The UK SMB Hunter team is responsible for winning net-new business across the SMB segment in the UK. We focus on bringing Stripe products to high-potential businesses that are not yet Stripe customers. We move with urgency, operate with focus, and pride ourselves on delivering strong commercial results through disciplined outbound execution and high-quality customer engagement. What you'll do As an Account Executive on the UK SMB Hunter team, you will own a portfolio of prospective SMB accounts and be responsible for winning new business for Stripe. This is a true hunting role, with a strong emphasis on outbound prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing new logos. You will partner closely with an SDR to execute targeted outbound strategies, while also building your own pipeline through proactive prospecting and account-based selling. You will run high-velocity, consultative sales cycles, help prospective users understand the value of the Stripe platform, and guide them from discovery through close and activation. **Responsibilities** * Own the full sales cycle for net-new SMB prospects, from prospecting and discovery through solutioning, negotiation, close, and activation * Build and execute outbound strategies across a named account set to create, progress, and close new business opportunities * Partner closely with SDRs to identify target accounts, refine messaging, and generate qualified pipeline, while also self-sourcing opportunities * Lead consultative sales conversations with founders, operators, and functional stakeholders across payments, finance, product, and engineering * Understand customer pain points and business objectives, and position Stripe products and solutions to meet their needs, while building trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders throughout the sales process * Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations to deliver strong outcomes for both Stripe and prospective users * Maintain a high bar for pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, and operational rigor Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * Proven success in a closing sales role with a strong focus on net-new business acquisition, or in a customer-facing role such as solution engineering, implementation consulting, or strategy consulting with demonstrated experience influencing commercial outcomes and executive decision-making * Experience managing outbound sales motions and building pipeline through a combination of SDR partnership and self-generated prospecting, or experience partnering closely with sales teams on account-based strategies that generate and progress new business opportunities * Ability to run high-velocity sales cycles while maintaining strong qualification, deal control, and forecasting discipline * Strong consultative selling skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, build business cases, and align solutions to buyer priorities * Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate the value of multi-product solutions to both business and technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills in English **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience selling payments, fintech, SaaS, or other technology solutions * Experience in a high-growth sales environment with strong outbound expectations * Experience working with founders and SMB decision-makers * Familiarity with account-based prospecting and territory planning In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €112,000 - €168,000. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

title: Account SE

Experience & Background We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you. **Core Experience (One Or More Of The Following)** * Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization. * Strategic Sales & Account Management: Experience in Account Management or Solution Selling, with a focus on navigating complex sales cycles and acting as a strategic partner to sales leadership. * SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture. * Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps. * Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background—this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development. **Required Skills & Qualifications** The Foundations * Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background. We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role. * Strategic Partnering: Experience acting as a strategic partner to sales or business units, helping to steer the direction of a deal or project. * Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI. You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success. * Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges. Key Professional Skills * Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal. * Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention. * Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Experience & Adaptability * Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap. * Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally. Language Requirements * Fluency in English plus one or more additional languages is required from the following: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Hebrew, Arabic, French or one of the main Eastern European languages (e.g., Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian). **Preferred Qualifications** * Salesforce Ecosystem: Existing Salesforce product knowledge and certifications (e.g., AI Associate, Administrator, or Cloud Consultant) are highly preferred. * SaaS Mastery: Experience or background in solution selling and the enterprise software landscape. * Education: Degree or equivalent proven experience (including extracurricular leadership, military experience, or volunteer roles). Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Advanced Manufacturing Technician (API) APICOM
description: **Advanced Manufacturing Technician (API)** **College Park, Dublin** **Full Time, Permanent (shift based)** AstraZeneca are taking bold actions to create new ways to make life-saving medicines. By doing this we can deliver medicines to patients faster, cheaper, and more sustainably. This will help us reach our ambitious goals. We are building a next-generation active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing facility for small molecules near Dublin, Ireland. This new plant will help us optimize our work and improve our efficiency. It will use cutting-edge process technology and digital innovations. All to be able to meet the needs of AstraZeneca's exciting new pipeline! **This will be a shift position and the type of shift is subject to change to meet business requirements. Emergency Response Team (ERT) membership will be included as a core responsibility.** **This Is What You Will Do** As a member of the operations team, you’ll carry out multi-stage Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing processes in compliance with AstraZeneca, GMP & SHE standards. **In Addition, You Will Also** * Provide operational expertise at accommodation meetings such as processing risk assessments. * Reinforce standards required in terms of GMP, SHE and specific product requirements * Receive, accept, locate, store, dispatch and deliver products and materials and complete all relevant documentation to meet GMP and SHE standards * Collaborate with the relevant function to receive and return the materials/components that feed into the production process. * Set-up routings for production, change over and cleans and maintain relevant equipment to enable the smooth running of the plant unit. * Perform and document the results of equipment cleaning hot spot inspections * Carry out ‘free from gross contamination’ cleaning inspections **Essential Skills/Experience** * Excellent team player with problem solving skills who thrives in a collaborative team environment. * Team player and good collaborator * GMP and regulatory knowledge/awareness * Applicants should be educated to a minimum of leaving certificate /relevant trade. * Experience from API production or other pharmaceutical manufacturing * Excellent Documentation Practices and Computer skills * Lean awareness. * Strong safety attitude and approach to training/workload timely completion **Desirable Experience** * Previous start up experience * Documentation generation (drafting initial SOPs, MBR, LIMS sampling plans etc) * Familiar with manufacturing process systems e.g. Delta V * Lean qualification. * Familiar with Electronic batch records. * Experience of investigations and CAPAs and change controls. * Experience of Tank farm operations. * Excellent IT skills (excel, word, title: Associate Interior Designer
description: Ruumi Studio is an architecture and interior design practice with studios in Dublin and Manchester, and a presence in London. We began in early 2026 as a spin-out from an international real estate firm, and we brought our live portfolio and our design IP with us. It meant we skipped the year most new practices spend chasing work. We opened with a full order book and it has stayed full. In our first year we have delivered over 250,000 sq ft and been nominated for four awards so far this year. Around half our work is commercial fit-out. A quarter is heritage and deep retrofit. The balance runs across aviation, industrial and workplace. The interiors work here is not decoration applied at the end of an architectural process. It is the project. We own a furniture dealership. This changes the job. Indi is our furniture dealership, and it sits inside the group. We hold the manufacturer relationships directly, on our own terms, with the trading account in our name. For a designer, that means several things that are unusual in this market. You can specify having actually sat in the thing. You can get a sample in the studio in days rather than negotiating with somebody else’s rep. You can hold a real conversation about lead time, price and substitution at the point of specification instead of discovering the problem at tender. And when a client’s budget moves, you have commercial room to move with it rather than starting the schedule again. The obvious question is whether that means you will be pushed to specify in-group product. No. The dealership serves the design work, not the other way round. If the right answer is a manufacturer we do not represent, we specify it. A practice that lets the trading account drive the specification is not a design practice, it is a sales operation with drawings. Lad Lane We move into a new studio on Lad Lane in September. Two floors of a self-contained mews, with the Indi showroom on the ground floor. Your samples and your specification library will be one staircase away, and you will have a hand in what goes into the space. We designed it ourselves, which seemed like the minimum standard for a practice that spends its days telling other organisations how their workplace should perform. It is not, on the evidence of visiting our competitors, an industry norm. The nine-day fortnight Every second Friday off, from your first day. Not a pilot, not something you earn after probation. The reasoning is unromantic. This industry has a well-documented habit of consuming people at exactly the point they become properly good at the job. We would rather not, and then congratulate ourselves on the overtime. What we ask for Two things, and neither is negotiable. Revit proficiency. Not “familiar with”. If your workflow is currently SketchUp and hope, this is not the right role. You can model, detail and coordinate without somebody standing behind you. An inquisitive mind. The sort of person who disappears down a rabbit hole on a Friday afternoon and comes back knowing how something works, or why a material behaves the way it does. That is the list. We will teach the rest. What helps • Commercial office, workplace or fit-out experience. It is the bulk of what we do. • FF&E specification experience, and opinions about it. You will have more influence over specification here than at most practices, so bring some. • You are already augmenting your design or documentation workflow with AI. We are building the practice around this rather than waiting to see how it settles. • Comfort working with existing and historic building fabric. A quarter of our work involves buildings that push back. • Professional membership is welcome but not required. There is no register for interior design in Ireland and we are not going to pretend there is a proxy for talent. Pay Senior / Associate: €58,000 to €78,000 Bands are set by capability, not by years served. What matters is what you can run unsupervised, what you can specify with authority, and what you can hold in front of a client. Where you land in a band follows from that rather than from how comfortable you are asking. Some people find that conversation easy and some find it excruciating, and we would rather pay for the work than for the confidence. What you get • The nine-day fortnight, as above. • Real responsibility on live projects, early. • Direct access to the directors, and to the manufacturers. • At senior and associate level, a defined leadership pathway that ends in a position of real responsibility across both the studio and the dealership. There is more than one way to build a career here and we would rather be explicit about that now. • We submit our B Corp application in Q1 2027, once we have a full year of trading behind us. Not certified yet, and we will not pretend otherwise. Practical Lad Lane, Dublin 2. Hybrid, minimum three days a week in the studio. Before you apply At a practice this size you can find out exactly who you would be working with before you send anything. That is harder to do with a hundred-person studio, where you meet whoever is free on the day. One of our co-founders was on Architecture Social recently, talking about how Ruumi is run, how we build around AI and what we actually look for when hiring. It was not recorded with recruitment in mind, which is rather the point. https://open.spotify.com/episode/7o1RoOQ1gXHaBPZi5Jftdd To apply CV and portfolio to www.ruumi.studio/careers. PDF, under 10MB, we are begging you. Include a short paragraph on a material, a product or a specification decision you got wrong once, and what you do differently now. We read that before the covering letter.

title: Christmas Customer Assistant

Working in store is a real team effort, so you'll need to be flexible and ready to step into different areas to keep things running smoothly. You'll feel good knowing you're playing your part and enjoy a strong sense of teamwork and fun as everyone pulls together during our busiest season. If you enjoy helping people, staying busy and being part of a supportive team, this could be the role for you. *This is a temporary role, with the potential for longer-term opportunities depending on local availability.* **You Will** **What you'll be doing** * Welcome customers, understand their needs and help them find the right products, gifts, services and offers. * Create memorable customer experiences through friendly, personalised service. * Help customers complete purchases using tills and self-checkouts. * Replenish stock and keep shelves full * Support deliveries and help organise stock in the stockroom. * Keep the store and shopping areas look their best. * Work across different areas of the store and support your team wherever help is needed. **What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)** * Available to work Bank Holidays including Black Friday week and weekend, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve, St Stephen's Day and New Year's Day. * Customer-focused — enjoys talking to people and helping customers have a great experience. * Team player — supports others and cares about team success. * Operations ready — comfortable balancing customer service with stock, fulfilment and shop floor tasks. * Proactive attitude — sees what needs doing and takes ownership. * Resilient — stays positive and focused during busy periods. * Energy and stamina — keeps energy high throughout long, active shifts. * Confident asking questions — asks for help when needed to get things right. * Comfortable with technology — learns new systems and confidently uses handheld devices, tills and self-checkouts. **It would be great if you also have** * Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment. * Familiarity with Boots products and services. **Where your brilliance can take you** You’ll receive industry-recognised training and build valuable experience along the way. You may go on to explore more in Retail, Pharmacy, Beauty or Opticians, or ultimately progress into management. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best. **We hope to hear from you soon. Be brilliant with Boots.**

Let’s find out together. At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all. Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter. This role is part of our Cover-More Europe team. Cover-More Europe provides insurance solutions through a number of different customer-facing brands across travel, car hire, specialty, and pet sectors in the United Kingdom, Ireland and the rest of Europe. For more than twenty years, we have been delivering insurance policies through our distribution partnerships. We know what is important to our partners, and we deliver simple and seamless customer experiences based on our genuine commitment to protection and care. The start date for this role is Monday 16th November 2026 and is based in our Blanchardstown office: Suite 11, Fifth Floor, No. 2 Stemple Exchange, Blanchardstown Corporate Park D15 E4FN The training period for this role is approximately 8 weeks. We want to ensure you are set up for success, so our preference is for there to be no holidays in this time. What’s the job? Join a team that makes a real difference for travellers worldwide! In this role, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers and partners, delivering exceptional service and guidance that ensures our customers can travel with confidence. * You’ll provide clear, accurate, and compliant advice on travel insurance policies, coverage, and claims. * You’ll handle enquiries across phone, email, and messaging channels, turning challenges into positive experiences. * You’ll understand customer needs, offer tailored solutions, and ensure satisfaction from start to finish. * You’ll interpret policy details and coverage levels to resolve queries efficiently and in line with procedures. * You’ll aim to meet and exceed quality, response time, and customer satisfaction targets while managing queries within agreed timelines. * You’ll escalate complex issues when needed, ensuring every customer feels supported and valued. What are we looking for? * You’ll have strong written and verbal communication skills – you can communicate with anyone * You’ll have previous customer service or sales experience, ideally within a call centre environment, however this is not essential * You’ll have the ability to assess information quickly with attention to detail and ask questions when required * You’ll have a passion for providing customer service and solving customer problems * You’ll be flexible with shifts including weekdays and occasional weekends/bank holidays as required Why choose us? We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results focus and forward-thinking. We have more than 2900 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey. Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy – after an initial training period – ensures our employees maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home. Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business - not for the business! Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme. Travel and work with us. We’ll help you keep travelling in your career, oh and quite literally with free travel insurance…so start planning for your next trip today! Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are. Apply today and let’s go great places together! Cover-More Services Limited is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland and authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority for UK Business. At Zurich Cover-More, compensation for roles is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. We are committed to providing a fair and reasonable compensation range for each role and additional rewards may include short-term incentive bonuses and increases based on merit. If your salary expectations are not in line with the proposed salary published for this role, you are still encouraged to apply. title: EDA Tooling, Release & Sign-off Engineer
description: We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape how we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence — from self-driving cars to learning machines — and we lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration that power high-performance silicon and software. Within our HPC Controller IP organization, the infrastructure and release team owns the EDA tooling, automation, and quality gates that build, package, verify, and release complex soft IP at scale. We make sure every product is assembled correctly, passes its release testing, and is signed off with confidence before it reaches customers. You Are: A motivated engineer who enjoys EDA tooling, flow automation, and owning the product release and sign-off process — with genuine enthusiasm for automation, quality, and using AI to raise engineering productivity, debug speed, and quality of results. You take ownership of getting a product packaged correctly, tested, and released on schedule. You partner naturally with design, verification, and implementation teams, communicate clearly, and let data guide your decisions. Logic-engineering know-how (synthesis, STA, and similar) is a welcome bonus rather than a prerequisite. What You’ll Be Doing: * Own and execute the product release process for complex soft IP: assemble and package deliverables, verify that contents and configurations are complete and correct, and produce clean release collateral. * Run release testing and sign-off: exercise release regressions and quality gates, confirm the product is packaged correctly, and sign off deliverables before they ship to customers and downstream teams. * Develop, run, and maintain EDA tooling, flow automation, and project infrastructure (Tcl/Python/Make-based), plus dashboards that track release status and quality. * Debug tooling and release failures end to end: analyze logs and reports, isolate root cause, communicate status and risks clearly, and drive issues to closure with design, verification, and implementation teams. * Apply AI to accelerate the work (e.g., triaging flow and release logs, summarizing regression and QoR trends, drafting and refactoring scripts). * Improve documentation, packaging and sign-off criteria, and reusable collateral so releases stay consistent and repeatable across IP programs. * Bonus: contribute to mid-end logic flows — synthesis, DFT, static checking (SpyGlass), formal equivalence, and power analysis — where it supports release readiness. The Impact You Will Have: * Products released on time, packaged correctly, and signed off with confidence. * Faster, more scalable execution through stronger automation and AI-enabled analysis. * Packaging, release, and quality-gate issues caught earlier in the cycle. * Tighter collaboration and clearer communication across the design-to-release chain. * Robust, implementation-ready soft IP shipped with clear collateral, checks, and sign-off. What You’ll Need (Core): * Working knowledge of EDA tooling and flow/automation development, typically gained through 2+ years of relevant experience or equivalent project work. * Experience with — or strong aptitude for — product release and sign-off: packaging deliverables, running release regressions, and verifying content and quality gates. * Good scripting skills (Tcl and/or Python) and a practical, automation-first mindset. * Comfort with build/packaging systems, revision control (e.g., Perforce or Git), and regression/CI flows. * Enough understanding of ASIC design and verification flows to support and debug the tooling around them. * Ability to use AI tools effectively to accelerate debugging, summarize results, and improve scripts and flows. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize issues, explain release status and risks, and align cross-functional teams on next steps * BS/MS in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Nice to have (Bonus): * Hands-on logic engineering: synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), DFT, static checking (SpyGlass), formal equivalence (e.g., Formality), or power analysis. * Hands-on with Synopsys tools such as Fusion Compiler, VC SpyGlass, or Formality. * IP development methodologies, IP packaging, or reusable IP delivery / release collateral. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines, regression frameworks, or reporting dashboards. Who You Are: * Proactive, curious, and adaptable. * Collaborative, communicative, and ethical. * Flow-oriented, AI-aware, and quality focused. * Resilient and results oriented. The Team You’ll Be A Part Of: You’ll work with a high-impact High-Performance-Compute team focused on delivering complex IP to the marketplace. You will collaborate across RTL design, verification, DFT, physical design, methodology, and project infrastructure teams to improve mid-end readiness and enable predictable downstream implementation. Rewards and Benefits: We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Your recruiter will provide more details about salary and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Founder’s Associate, Go-to-market
description: Banks are deciding now how AI will change the way they serve small business customers, and Narrative is a core part of those conversations. We build Narrative Coach, an AI relationship manager that banks and lenders offer inside their own app. It helps owners understand their finances, plan ahead and explore growth, and connects their needs with the right products and people at their provider. This role sits at the centre of how we grow. Working directly with Michael Dowling, our CEO and co-founder, you’ll help decide which institutions we go after, get us in front of the people who make decisions there, and turn first meetings into pilots and contracts. You’ll also design how we do it, with AI built into every step, so a small team can reach far more banks than its size would suggest. **What you’ll achieve** In your first months you’ll learn the product and the market alongside Michael. Within a year, we’d expect you to be leading most of this: * Building our pipeline of banks and lenders: identifying the institutions where Coach fits best, reaching the senior people who decide, and bringing a steady run of serious conversations to the table. * Putting on a series of events for senior people in banking, such as invitation-only lunches in London on the future of small business banking, and turning the people who attend into customers and partners. * Moving opportunities from first meeting to pilot to contract with Michael, and owning the preparation and proposals that win them. * Designing the AI tools and automations behind our go-to-market, from research to outreach to meeting preparation, and measuring what they change. * Building Narrative’s voice in the market, turning customer conversations, events and our view of where banking is heading into content senior bankers want to read. **Who we’re looking for** This role suits someone with real drive who wants responsibility early. You might come from a startup, sales, events, consulting, or a large firm where you wanted more say than you were given. You might plan to start your own company one day and want to learn how it’s done first. What you’ve done and how you think matter more to us than a particular degree or career path. You’ll probably recognise yourself in the following: * People energise you. You’re comfortable approaching a senior banker at an event, picking up the phone, and following through until something happens. * You make things happen, including when the starting point is unclear and nobody has done it before. * You’re commercially minded and want to see your work turn into signed customers. * You’re impatient with routine work and use AI tools to get it done, so your time goes on people and ideas. You’ve built automations of your own, though you don’t need to be an engineer. * You write well for busy, senior readers. * You’re curious about how small businesses run and how banks serve them. If you match some of this and not all of it, we’d still like to hear from you. **What you’ll get** * A central role in an early-stage company already working across multiple banks, in the room for the commercial decisions that shape where Narrative goes next. * Experience few people gain this early: selling AI to regulated financial institutions in several countries, alongside a CEO who has spent more than a decade working on AI in finance. * A role built to grow. Depending on your strengths and where the company goes, it can lead to Go-to-market Lead, Chief of Staff to the CEO, or leading Narrative’s entry into a new market. * A salary at market rate, depending on experience, plus equity in Narrative. * A learning plan you choose, with agreed time to pursue it, in a team that reviews its work openly and gives direct feedback. **How we hire** 1. You apply here on LinkedIn. 2. A conversation with Michael about you, the role and where you want to take your career. We’ll ask you to talk us through something you took from an unclear starting point to a useful result. 3. A work sample built around a real challenge we face in reaching banks. We’re interested in how you think and how you put AI to work on a problem, and we’ll talk it through with you afterwards. 4. Finalists spend time with the team, including time outside a formal interview. If you have a disability, a health condition or other circumstances that affect how you can take part, tell us what would help, at any stage, by emailing Michael at michael.dowling@narrativebanking.com. That could be extra time on the work sample, questions in advance, a different format, or a phone call in place of a video interview. We’ll work with you to put it in place. You can read more about the team and how we work at narrativebanking.com/careers. We use your application only to assess it for this role, and we delete any copies we hold within six months of the role being filled unless you ask us to keep them on file.

title: Online Internship Programme - Tesco Ireland

This is an exciting opportunity to learn about our business, work alongside experienced colleagues, and contribute to projects that make a real difference for our customers, colleagues and the planet. Our Online team is focused on delivering a seamless shopping experience for millions of customers. During your internship, you'll gain exposure to the fast-paced world of e-commerce and learn how Tesco develops, manages and grows its online business. We work in an agile way, continually testing, learning and moving quickly to improve the customer experience. You may have the opportunity to work with teams and initiatives such as Whoosh. Throughout the programme, you'll develop valuable workplace skills, build your professional network and work in a supportive and inclusive environment. From day one, you'll be encouraged to bring your ideas, challenge yourself and discover where your strengths and interests lie. Demonstrating Tesco values in everything you do and contributing positively to an inclusive team environment. Using customer, market and performance data to identify opportunities to improve the online shopping experience. Working within agile teams to test, learn and implement improvements that deliver value for customers. **You will need** A genuine curiosity and desire to learn, develop and grow both personally and professionally. A positive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to embrace change and approach challenges as opportunities. Good organisation skills and the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines. Enthusiasm, initiative, and a proactive attitude towards learning and problem-solving. A strong team spirit, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive working environment. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​ We strive to do great things with great people. description: **Description** Keeping our people safe and well at work is a top priority at Amazon. Our Safety Technicians play an essential role in making this happen. This role is an opportunity to start your career in workplace safety and develop through a global company. You’ll work closely with our experts to monitor your site, which means you’ll get to see the difference that you make to people’s well-being every day. Key job responsibilities Carry out risk assessments and audits Monitor the site to make sure processes are in line with Amazon's safety procedures Create and update reports on safety metrics for colleagues to review Work with colleagues in Operations and across the business on safety-related tasks and offer guidance on processes Support in putting new safety measures in place A day in the life You'll be based at one of our sites. You'll spend a lot of time checking the site and getting to know the way that people use equipment. By understanding how every task and machine works, you'll be able to think about the best way to keep processes safe. You'll also be one of the people to put safety changes into action, which means you'll get to work closely with lots of people. You'll also share that data with people across the business and work with other teams to make sure they're putting safety first. **About The Team** The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. title: Veterinary Practitioner - Mixed
description: **Veterinary Surgeon - Mixed Practice** **Gorey Veterinary Hospital, Co Wexford** **Full-time, Part-time & Flexible Working Arrangements Considered** **Salary up to €75,000 DOE** **Clinic Vehicle Included** **Enjoy the Variety That Only Mixed Practice Can Offer** For many veterinary surgeons, the appeal of mixed practice is simple: no two days are ever quite the same. At Gorey Veterinary Hospital, we're looking for an experienced Mixed Veterinary Surgeon to join our growing and ambitious team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a clinician who enjoys maintaining a diverse skillset, thrives on variety, and values the opportunity to work across both companion animal and farm animal cases within a supportive and progressive environment. Our practice is currently in an exciting period of growth and development, with recent investment in both our facilities and our people. As we continue to build for the future, we're looking for experienced clinicians who can confidently contribute from day one while helping us continue to deliver exceptional veterinary care to the communities we serve. Whether you're seeking a full-time position, part-time opportunities or a more tailored working arrangement, we're happy to have an open discussion about what works best for you. **A Genuine Mixed Caseload** This is a true mixed practice role, offering the diversity that attracts so many vets to the profession in the first place. With a caseload comprising approximately 70% small animal and 30% farm animal work, alongside a small amount of equine involvement, you'll enjoy a varied and engaging clinical workload. From consultations, surgery and medical investigations within the clinic, to farm visits, herd health work and TB testing in the field, you'll have the opportunity to utilise and develop a broad range of skills. This role is ideally suited to a veterinarian who enjoys balancing different aspects of practice and values the challenge and reward that comes from working across multiple disciplines. **A Growing Practice with an Exciting Future** Gorey Veterinary Hospital continues to invest in its facilities, equipment and team as part of an exciting period of development. Recent improvements have enhanced our clinical capabilities and strengthened our ability to provide excellent patient care across both companion animal and farm services. Alongside these investments, we're continuing to grow our team and create an environment where experienced clinicians can thrive, contribute ideas and play a meaningful role in shaping the future of the practice. You'll be joining a collaborative and approachable team that genuinely enjoys working together and takes pride in supporting one another. **Clinical Independence with Strong Team Support** We're seeking an experienced veterinary surgeon who is comfortable managing a varied caseload and making independent clinical decisions. This position is not suitable for new graduates or clinicians who require ongoing mentorship and close supervision. Instead, we're looking for someone with proven experience in first-opinion practice who is confident handling routine consultations, surgery and farm work within a mixed setting. While clinical confidence and independence are important, you'll always be part of a supportive team environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing and professional respect are central to our culture. **Flexibility That Starts with a Conversation** We recognise that every veterinarian's ideal working pattern looks different, and we're keen to build a role around the right person rather than asking candidates to fit into a rigid schedule. As a guide, our full-time vets typically work an average of 40 hours per week across a combination of weekday shifts between 8:30am and 5:30pm or 10:30am and 7:30pm. We are happy to discuss full-time, part-time and flexible working arrangements, and welcome conversations around alternative schedules that support both your professional ambitions and personal commitments. To ensure a fair and sustainable rota for the entire team, participation in our 1 in 6 Saturday rota and 1 in 6 weekend on-call rota is a requirement of the role, including for those working part-time or flexible contracts. Saturday clinics run from 9:00am to 2:30pm, with a half day of TOIL provided, while a full day of TOIL follows an on-call weekend. Importantly, the practice is not open to the public on Sundays or Bank Holidays, and our out-of-hours service is shared with a neighbouring veterinary practice, helping to distribute workload and support a healthy work-life balance for the team. **Live and Work in Beautiful Wexford** Located in the heart of Ireland's sunny south east, Gorey offers an exceptional quality of life alongside a welcoming and vibrant community. With beautiful beaches, excellent local amenities, outstanding transport links and easy access to both Dublin and Wexford, it provides an ideal setting for veterinarians looking to combine career satisfaction with an enviable lifestyle. **Who We're Looking For** We're seeking a VCI-registered Veterinary Surgeon with previous clinical experience in mixed practice. The ideal candidate will enjoy the diversity of mixed work, be comfortable working across both companion animal and farm animal cases, and possess the confidence to manage routine first-opinion responsibilities with minimal supervision. Strong communication skills, sound clinical judgement and a collaborative approach are all essential. title: Warehouse Operative

title: CRM Marketing Executive
description: RTÉ is Ireland's national public-service media organisation. We are embarking upon an ambitious and exciting 5-year transformation strategy to update the way we run the organisation. Our mission is to serve as an independent source of stories, news, information and entertainment for Ireland, reflecting the diversity of its people and providing experiences that enrich the lives of all. This sense of purpose motivates us to deliver to the highest standards in an environment that is collaborative, supportive and engaging. Attracting and retaining the best talent is key in delivering to our audiences. We want our people to thrive in an environment that values their output. **Meet the team** As RTÉ’s marketing team we are responsible for promoting RTÉ’s content, channels, product and service brands across all marketing platforms (on and off RTÉ) reaching audiences through the delivery of an overarching consumer-facing marketing strategy. RTÉ is looking for an experienced CRM Marketing Executive to join its busy consumer-facing Marketing team on a 3-year fixed term contract basis. This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and data-driven CRM marketer to support the growth of RTÉ’s digital services. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for planning and executing campaigns across multiple marketing and CRM channels, – including but not limited to email marketing, push notifications and in-app messages, as business needs grow. You’ll build audience segments and create engaging communications, working closely with colleagues across marketing, content, editorial, product, technology and external suppliers. **About The Role** * Support the delivery of the annual marketing plan across a full range of marketing activities. * Build and manage CRM campaigns using the Marketing Automation tool. * Plan, deliver and optimise CRM strategies to drive reach, traffic, retention and brand loyalty. * Create and maintain audience segments and customer journeys to deliver personalised communications. * Write briefs and channel-appropriate copy for marketing emails, push notifications and other channels. * Curate RTÉ content and develop ideas for CRM communications to increase engagement and traffic. * Brief and work with graphic designers to develop creative assets for CRM. * Monitor and analyse campaign performance, producing regular reports and insights for stakeholders. * Work closely with cross-functional teams (marketing, editorial, content, product, technology, design and external suppliers) to execute campaigns effectively. * Support the ongoing maintenance and data structure within the CRM Automation tool, working with our development team and supplier to facilitate. * Support team projects, administration and financial management tasks. **About You** * A third level qualification in marketing or similar, combined with 2+ years’ experience in a consumer facing digital environment - agency or client side. * Proven experience executing CRM campaigns using XtremePush or a similar platform is essential, including the ability to build, execute and analyse campaigns. * Excellent copywriting skills are essential, with the ability to write engaging, audience-focused copy for marketing emails and push notifications. * A strong creative eye and experience building visually engaging CRM campaigns, with an understanding of how copy, imagery, layout and user experience work together to drive engagement. * Experience briefing and working with graphic designers to deliver CRM assets. * Knowledge of the back end of CRM systems such as XtremePush and the ability to work with development teams on set up and maintenance. * Analytical skills with experience in reporting and campaign measurement. * Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work with cross-functional teams. * Strong attention to detail and organisational skills to deliver in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. * Proficient in Excel. **How To Apply** If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit the below as **one combined document** : * your CV * an introduction paragraph of no more than 300 words outlining where/how you match the requirements of this role This appointment will be made at the Administrative Grade 2 and is being offered on a 3-year fixed term contract basis. The salary scale for this grade is from €37,019 to €51,662 gross per annum. Closing date for receipt of applications is Wednesday 28th October 2026. title: Customer Graduate Programme - Tesco Ireland
description: **About the role** The Customer Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic background that broadens your commercial understanding and develops new skills Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests within the Customer function, allowing you to build expertise and make a meaningful impact Each placement is structured around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, ensuring you can track your development while contributing to key business priorities. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of customer-focused areas, including: Customer Insight and Analytics Clubcard and Loyalty Programmes Customer Experience and Service Improvement Customer Strategy and Planning Digital Customer Journeys Customer Communications and Engagement Market Research and Customer Trends Customer-Focused Innovation Projects You’ll work with cross-functional teams to understand customer needs, analyse customer feedback and data, identify opportunities for improvement, and help deliver initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a deep understanding of how customer-led decisions drive business growth, build loyalty, and support Tesco’s purpose of serving customers, communities, and the planet a little better every day. Salary: €35,000 Programme start date: 6 September 2027 **You will be responsible for** Alongside your day-to-day responsibilities, you’ll take part in a structured 18-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on customer insight, retail operations, and business strategy Personal development sessions to build confidence, communication, and leadership skills Store visits and customer immersion experiences to understand our customers firsthand Networking opportunities with graduates and leaders across the business Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues who will support your development throughout the programme At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are committed to helping you succeed. **You will need** A genuine curiosity and desire to learn, develop and grow both personally and professionally. An interest in customers, marketing, brands and understanding what drives customer behaviour. A positive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to embrace change and approach challenges as opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to share ideas and ask questions. A collaborative approach and a willingness to work effectively as part of a team. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in using data and insights to support decision-making. A strong team spirit, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive working environment. **Whats in it for you?** Our Customer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are passionate about understanding customers and creating outstanding experiences. If you’re curious about customer behaviour, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real difference to how customers interact with Tesco, this programme will give you the opportunity to build a rewarding career in one of the most customer-focused retail businesses in Ireland. From day one, you’ll be part of a collaborative team working on initiatives that help us better understand our customers, improve their shopping experience, and strengthen customer loyalty. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that influence how we engage with customers across stores, online, and through our Clubcard programme. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum **About Us** Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. At Tesco, inclusion means that Everyone’s Welcome. Everyone is treated fairly and with respect; by valuing individuality and uniqueness we create a sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the heart of Tesco. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. Across the Tesco group we are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Our office is based in Dun Laoghaire, Co. Dublin and Tesco has embraced hybrid working. We have open plan offices and informal breakout spaces so teams can collaborate together. We’ve a subsidised colleague restaurant for all breakfast, lunch and snack requirements. At the weekly “Team 5” update you'll get to hear about exciting events happening across our stores and any important business updates. We have stunning views of Dublin Bay from our office and are ideally located next to public transport options and lots of handy amenities in the local area.
